claim: One minimal Phase B conformance adapter test that loads a KeySuite vector JSONL row and asserts kernel compose/imply behavior OR explicitly xfails with a documented gap.

Update docs/KEYSUITE_BRIDGE.md with a Phase B spike section recording the chosen path and any gap.
